content: This is the discussion thread for #General announcements > Axiomatic Octo Search: Semantic Search for Any Lean Projects .
Did you benchmark the accuracy of Octo Search against other state-of-the-art semantic search programs like LeanSearch?

Yes, we used the benchmark by LeanSearch itself. We thought the best thing was to release the "executable" itself first so that people could benefit from it straight away. Then comes the code, some benchmarks of our own, and a report explaining things more in detail

On another note we are revamping the UI to make it more friendly after some feedback from people that have started using it, so you should see it change a bit in the next week or so (though there's no need to wait to try and use it ; )

Jack McCarthy said:

Did you benchmark the accuracy of Octo Search against other state-of-the-art semantic search programs like LeanSearch?

Elaborating some on what Luigi said, we evaluated on MathlibQR from the LeanSearch v2 paper. On the same subset, our best configuration reaches 0.765 nDCG@10 / 0.914 Recall@10, against the 0.623 / 0.780 reported for LeanSearch v2 (Table 1). The configuration we ship makes some tradeoffs for lower query latency. The upcoming technical report will give more details plus the ablations for what drove the gain.
Octo search recently added a permission request for Read-only access to Email addresses. Is there a particular reason for this change ?

Alex Nguyen said:

Octo search recently added a permission request for Read-only access to Email addresses. Is there a particular reason for this change ?

We added this permission to address a sign-in issue affecting users with private GitHub email addresses. We've since identified a way to support those accounts without requiring this additional permission, so we're removing it.

Octo's repository indexing permissions haven't changed. You can hold off on approving the prompt for now, and I'll follow up here as soon as the change is deployed.
We've now removed the additional email permission, so you should be able to sign in to Octo without seeing that prompt. Let me know if you run into any issues!
